sections.label: HDB environmental baseline study, Forest Corridor
sections.summary: HDB is conducting an environmental baseline study and plans a 100-metre-wide, 5-kilometre Forest Corridor, a naturalised stream and water body.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: As part of responsible development, HDB is conducting an environmental baseline study so as to better understand the existing topography, hydrology, flora and existing wildlife in the area.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: We will share the key findings of the study with the public in due course.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: One key feature which HDB has planned is the Forest Corridor which is approximately 100 metres wide and 5 kilometres long and will serve as a wildlife connector between the Western Water Catchment Area and the Central Catchment Nature Reserve.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: The plan is also to replace the concrete canal with a naturalised stream and water body.

sections.label: HDB wildlife management strategies
sections.summary: HDB will put in place wildlife management strategies, including shepherding wildlife to adjacent forest areas not developed in the short term.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: HDB will put in place wildlife management strategies, which will include shepherding wildlife to the adjacent forest areas that will not be developed in the short term.

sections.label: Environmental baseline study completion date
sections.summary: The environmental baseline study is expected to be completed by the first half of 2017.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: First, with regard to the environmental baseline study, we expect it to be completed by the first half of 2017.

sections.label: Consulting stakeholders, publishing EIA findings
sections.summary: HDB is consulting stakeholders including nature and animal welfare groups, and the findings will be made public unless specific considerations require otherwise.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: HDB is consulting various stakeholders, which include nature and animal welfare groups.

sentences.speaker: Mr Leon Perera (Non-Constituency Member)
sentences.text: In relation to this EIA, is it the case that, henceforth, all EIA or EIS studies will be made public if there are done, unless there are specific national security considerations that prohibit public release and, if that is not the case, then why is that not the case?

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: It is the case that for these environmental impact assessments and, in this case, the environmental baseline study, the findings will be made public, unless there are specific considerations that require otherwise.
